## Description {#details}

<p>This class represents a composition of other <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scev">SCEV</a> predicates, and is the class that most clients will interact with.</p>


<p>This is equivalent to a logical "AND" of all the predicates in the union.</p>


<p>NB! Unlike other <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scevpredicate">SCEVPredicate</a> sub-classes this class does not live in the ScalarEvolution::Preds folding set. This is why the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">add</span> function is sound.</p>


<p>Definition at line 412 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/scalarevolution-h">ScalarEvolution.h</a>.</p>
